body.intent: Conductor workflow. Owner, 2026-11-13, after the overnight watch and the ship-change proposal (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vp1BQRYN5793H1N3GURe3h): an agent conducts each change set and spawns visible sessions through a dumb, durable daemon that only ships and guards; workflows are built from a few daemon primitives so teams bring their own skills and agents; the new default replaces the builtin ship-change at once.
